{
  "name": "lms-sis",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "private": true,
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "next dev",
    "build": "DATABASE_URL=file:./dev.db prisma db push --accept-data-loss && DATABASE_URL=file:./dev.db tsx seed.ts && next build",
    "start": "next start",
    "lint": "eslint",
    "postinstall": "prisma generate",
    "mcp": "tsx src/mcp.ts",
    "seed": "tsx seed.ts",
    "smoke:orchexa": "tsx scripts/orchexa-smoke.ts"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@base-ui/react": "^1.7.0",
    "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk": "^1.30.0",
    "@prisma/client": "^6.19.3",
    "class-variance-authority": "^0.7.1",
    "clsx": "^2.1.1",
    "date-fns": "^4.4.0",
    "lucide-react": "^1.37.0",
    "next": "16.3.3",
    "react": "19.2.8",
    "react-dom": "19.2.8",
    "shadcn": "^4.19.0",
    "tailwind-merge": "^3.6.0",
    "tsx": "^4.23.13",
    "tw-animate-css": "^1.4.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@tailwindcss/postcss": "^4",
    "@types/node": "^20",
    "@types/react": "^19",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19",
    "eslint": "^9",
    "eslint-config-next": "16.3.3",
    "prisma": "^6.19.3",
    "tailwindcss": "^4",
    "typescript": "^5"
  }
}

{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2017",
    "lib": ["dom", "dom.iterable", "esnext"],
    "allowJs": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "strict": true,
    "noEmit": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "module": "esnext",
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "isolatedModules": true,
    "jsx": "react-jsx",
    "incremental": true,
    "plugins": [
      {
        "name": "next"
      }
    ],
    "paths": {
      "@/*": ["./src/*"]
    }
  },
  "include": [
    "next-env.d.ts",
    "**/*.ts",
    "**/*.tsx",
    ".next/types/**/*.ts",
    ".next/dev/types/**/*.ts",
    "**/*.mts"
  ],
  "exclude": ["node_modules"]
}

{
  "$schema": "https://ui.shadcn.com/schema.json",
  "style": "base-nova",
  "rsc": true,
  "tsx": true,
  "tailwind": {
    "config": "",
    "css": "src/app/globals.css",
    "baseColor": "neutral",
    "cssVariables": true,
    "prefix": ""
  },
  "iconLibrary": "lucide",
  "rtl": false,
  "aliases": {
    "components": "@/components",
    "utils": "@/lib/utils",
    "ui": "@/components/ui",
    "lib": "@/lib",
    "hooks": "@/hooks"
  },
  "menuColor": "default",
  "menuAccent": "subtle",
  "registries": {}
}

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model User {
  id              String           @id @default(cuid())
  email           String           @unique
  name            String
  role            String           // ADMIN, SALES, CS, TEACHER, MANAGER
  facilityId      String?
  facility        Facility?        @relation(fields: [facilityId], references: [id])
  
  classes         Class[]          // Lớp học giáo viên phụ trách
  supportRequests SupportRequest[] // Yêu cầu hỗ trợ CS phụ trách
  logs            ActivityLog[]
  createdAt       DateTime         @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime         @updatedAt
}

model Facility {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String   // e.g., Cơ sở Cầu Giấy
  address   String
  rooms     Room[]
  classes   Class[]
  users     User[]
  leads     Lead[]
  students  Student[]
  orders    Order[]
}

model Room {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String
  capacity  Int
  facilityId String
  facility  Facility @relation(fields: [facilityId], references: [id])
  schedules Schedule[]
}

model Course {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  name        String
  code        String   @unique
  type        String   // e.g., Tiếng Anh giao tiếp, Toán tư duy
  targetAge   String?
  level       String?
  duration    Int      // Số buổi
  fee         Float?
  description String?
  status      String   @default("ACTIVE") // ACTIVE, PAUSED
  classes     Class[]
  leads       Lead[]   // Interests
  orders      Order[]
}

model Class {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  code        String   @unique
  name        String
  courseId    String
  course      Course   @relation(fields: [courseId], references: [id])
  teacherId   String?
  teacher     User?    @relation(fields: [teacherId], references: [id])
  facilityId  String
  facility    Facility @relation(fields: [facilityId], references: [id])
  capacity    Int
  status      String   @default("ONGOING") // ONGOING, COMPLETED, PAUSED
  students    Student[]
  schedules   Schedule[]
  attendances Attendance[]
}

model Parent {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String
  phone     String   @unique
  email     String?
  students  Student[]
  notes     String?
}

model Student {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  code        String   @unique
  name        String
  dob         DateTime?
  phone       String?
  parentId    String?
  parent      Parent?  @relation(fields: [parentId], references: [id])
  facilityId  String
  facility    Facility @relation(fields: [facilityId], references: [id])
  
  classes     Class[]
  attendances Attendance[]
  assignments Assignment[]
  supportRequests SupportRequest[]
  makeUpRequests  MakeUpRequest[]
  transferRequests TransferRequest[]
  orders          Order[]
  status      String   @default("ACTIVE") // ACTIVE, INACTIVE
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
}

model Schedule {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  classId     String
  class       Class    @relation(fields: [classId], references: [id])
  roomId      String
  room        Room     @relation(fields: [roomId], references: [id])
  date        DateTime // Date and time
  duration    Int      // in minutes
  status      String   @default("SCHEDULED") // SCHEDULED, COMPLETED, CANCELLED
  attendances Attendance[]
}

model Attendance {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  scheduleId  String
  schedule    Schedule @relation(fields: [scheduleId], references: [id])
  studentId   String
  student     Student  @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id])
  classId     String
  class       Class    @relation(fields: [classId], references: [id])
  status      String   // PRESENT, ABSENT, EXCUSED, LATE
  note        String?
  updatedBy   String?
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
  
  @@unique([scheduleId, studentId])
}

model Assignment {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  title       String
  studentId   String
  student     Student  @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id])
  score       Float?
  maxScore    Float?
  status      String   // COMPLETED, PENDING, LATE
  teacherNote String?
  date        DateTime @default(now())
}

model Lead {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  name        String
  phone       String
  courseId    String?
  course      Course?  @relation(fields: [courseId], references: [id])
  facilityId  String?
  facility    Facility? @relation(fields: [facilityId], references: [id])
  age         Int?
  source      String?
  status      String   @default("NEW") // NEW, CONTACTED, CONSULTING, TRIAL_BOOKED, TRIAL_DONE, ENROLLED, UNSUITABLE, UNREACHABLE
  notes       String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
}

model SupportRequest {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  studentId   String
  student     Student  @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id])
  type        String   // LEAVE, INFO, SUPPORT, COMPLAINT, CALL_BACK
  content     String
  status      String   @default("NEW") // NEW, IN_PROGRESS, PENDING, RESOLVED, REJECTED, CLOSED
  assigneeId  String?
  assignee    User?    @relation(fields: [assigneeId], references: [id])
  priority    String   @default("NORMAL") // LOW, NORMAL, HIGH
  notes       String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
}

model MakeUpRequest {
  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  studentId       String
  student         Student  @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id])
  missedScheduleId String
  targetScheduleId String
  status          String   @default("PENDING") // PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED
  notes           String?
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
}

model TransferRequest {
  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  studentId       String
  student         Student  @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id])
  fromClassId     String
  toClassId       String
  status          String   @default("PENDING") // PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED
  notes           String?
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
}

model ActivityLog {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId      String?
  user        User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  role        String?
  action      String
  entityType  String
  entityId    String
  details     String?  // JSON string
  source      String   @default("SYSTEM") // UI, API, AI_AGENT
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
}

model Order {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  code        String   @unique
  studentId   String?
  student     Student? @relation(fields: [studentId], references: [id])
  parentName  String
  parentPhone String
  courseId    String
  course      Course   @relation(fields: [courseId], references: [id])
  facilityId  String
  facility    Facility @relation(fields: [facilityId], references: [id])
  amount      Float
  status      String   @default("PENDING") // PENDING, PAID, CANCELLED
  notes       String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
}
